notes: CONTROLLED ONE-PAIR RESULT. The tar-layer patch is 625269 bytes: 6.608737% of the 9461248-byte target tar and 15.360022% of the 4070756-byte official compressed target. The already-recorded compressed-artifact patch for the identical pair is 3884546 bytes, or 95.425665% of the compressed target. Absolute patch savings are 3259277 bytes; the tar patch is 83.903679% smaller than the compressed-artifact patch. Patch application reconstructed the official target tar byte-for-byte. The full reconstructed-tar pipeline, passed through the installed cargo-tauri 2.10.1 / tauri-bundler 2.8.1 compression path, reproduced the official app.tar.gz byte-for-byte and verified with the existing release signature. Official compressed target BLAKE3: 718c104bfdcc00aaa7b588519ad62c2719a182d8e7364c1daf260ed8fbf96f36; SHA-256: f287ff6420d00353ec1df9b89dc65bed0e699c80790fb40493213be894affb84. A control using flate2 1.1.9 with its miniz_oxide 0.8.9 backend did not match (3936113 bytes, SHA-256 b23498278ce08d76a9b4b25c175458c26273c35d9cee97f9ba0cbb5b90941715; first difference at zero-based byte 12), demonstrating backend/feature-resolution coupling. The installed cargo-tauri binary resolves zlib-rs 0.6.3. This is one pair, not a general macOS or gzip claim. The prior E2E record's three fields named *_hash contain SHA-256 values despite SCHEMA.md requiring BLAKE3; this record uses BLAKE3 as required and preserves the old record unchanged.
artifact_provenance: Exact artifacts retained from experiment 2026-08-13-macos-real-app-e2e-delta under /private/tmp/delta-e2e-build. They were built from source commit 908e1d2c33fea65d3a91cef9f4a7db96512c4a62 by examples/desktop-app/e2e/build-versions.sh using cargo tauri build --features e2e-control, then exercised successfully by run-e2e.sh. Paths: v1.0.0/DeltaUpdaterExample.app.tar.gz, v1.0.1/DeltaUpdaterExample.app.tar.gz, patch.zst, manifest.json, and key.pub. Their sizes and SHA-256 values exactly match the preserved E2E record; the manifest target BLAKE3 matches the independently measured compressed target. Current HEAD differs only in E2E/research documentation and harness lines relevant after artifact creation; the ZstdBackend implementation is unchanged between artifact commit and current HEAD. Raw tar streams were obtained with gzip -dc, twice per artifact; repeat hashes and cmp matched. The tar patch was generated by current delta-release 0.1.0, which invokes the production ZstdBackend at level 19. Exact recompression was tested with the installed pinned cargo-tauri binary as the oracle, preserving the controlled tar metadata before tauri-bundler's append_dir_all call; both its emitted raw tar and gzip output were compared byte-for-byte to the official streams.
